1. ESTABLISH - RESIDENTIAL PERMIT PARKING AREA Y (Eligibility only, no signs)
318-338 Main Street; 333 Beale & 203 Folsom Streets (Supervisor District 6) (Requires approval by the
SFMTA Board) Gerry Porras, [staff email removed — see the order]

The proposed modification would add RPP eligibility to the residents of 318-338 Main Street, 333
Beale Street and 203 Folsom Street so they can purchase parking permits for their vehicle to park
within RPP Area Y.

Public Comments: No comments.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer to forward to the SFMTA Board for final approval and
implementation.
